tagline: Future-ready careers in the AI era
humanInCharge: You decide. Adept suggests options; it never makes hiring decisions.

landing.individualTitle: See where your skills can take you in the AI era
landing.individualBody: Tell us about yourself, see which skills are rising, get matched to future roles and follow a reskilling pathway linked to the SDGs.
landing.organisationTitle: Plan how your team or cohort reskills for AI
landing.organisationBody: For HR, L&D and career centres: team skills-gap heatmaps, group reskilling plans and an aggregated SDG view.

auth.consentBody: Adept uses only the information you enter to suggest options. You stay in charge of every decision.
auth.notImplemented: Real sign-in is not built yet. Use a demo account.
